# Reference license terms

These are standard license terms for declarations found in the locked crate
inventory. They are **not** recovered notices from the crates, and the generic
MIT placeholder is **not** a claim about any crate's copyright holder. Preserve
all upstream notices separately and keep evidence gaps visible in
`third_party/inventory.json` and `LICENSING.md`.

| CC0-1.0 | [CC0-1.0.txt](CC0-1.0.txt) | [SPDX License List Data v3.29.0](https://github.com/spdx/license-list-data/blob/v3.29.0/text/CC0-1.0.txt) | `a2010f343487d3f7618affe54f789f5487602331c0a8d03f49e9a7c547cf0499` |

MIT is the declared license for `block 0.1.6`, `dispatch 0.2.0`,
`malloc_buf 0.0.6`, `block2 0.6.2`, `objc2 0.6.5`, `objc2-encode 4.1.0`,
and `objc2-foundation 0.3.2`. It is one declared option for
`dispatch2 0.3.1`, `objc2-app-kit 0.3.2`, `objc2-core-foundation 0.3.2`,
`objc2-core-graphics 0.3.2`, and `objc2-io-surface 0.3.2`. CC0-1.0 is
declared for `hexf-parse 0.2.1`. PDF Squeeze selects the declared MIT option
for the multi-licensed crates; this does not resolve the separate Apple SDK question
or establish that all copyright notices have been recovered.
